description: Amazon product search and pricing API for AI agents: JSON product details by ASIN, keyword search results, offers and bestsellers. Supports Amazon marketplace domains for ecommerce research, with titles, prices, ratings and availability when available. Price: 1 prepaid credits per successful call. MCP returns a compact view of these results.

asin.description: Ten-character Amazon product identifier for a product lookup.

marketplace.description: Amazon marketplace domain suffix, such as com or co.uk.

query.description: Product search query; do not combine with asin.

results.description: Maximum number of Amazon search results to return.

name: search_amazon
title: Search Amazon
